name: Montreal

portalsFound.observation: Ville de Montreal open data (CC-BY 4.0 per CKAN): 'Unites d'evaluation fonciere', a polygon layer of property units for the agglomeration. The publisher states it has no legal value and must not be confused with the cadastral subdivision. Offered only as bulk CSV (76 MB), GeoJSON zip (176 MB) and Shapefile zip (145 MB); the CSV datastore has attributes but no geometry.
Quebec MRNF ArcGIS Server folder: WMS-oriented services; Droits_fonciers_WMS holds Crown land rights points/surfaces, not the cadastre of lots. No Cadastre du Quebec parcel query service found.
Donnees Quebec CKAN searched for cadastre/lots; only unrelated or small municipal line datasets found.
